data.name: Gerrilee
data.gender_notes: Gerrilee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Geras, meaning 'venerable' or 'age,' and the Latin lee, meaning 'shepherd.' In the Bible, Gerrilee could represent a joyful, venerable shepherdess, tending to her flock with faith and dedication. The name Gerrilee carries the meaning “Joyful shepherdess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gerrilee usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful shepherdess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of nurturing and guiding others.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerrilee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
